initialization_scope.application_limits: Binary loading, caller argument preparation, disk/ROM latency, ULA, real IRQ scheduling and a complete application cold boot are outside this service-entry benchmark. Do not call it complete application CPU.
initialization_scope.invocation: All recorded entry-through-RET costs exclude caller CALL17; every internal CALL/RET is included.
initialization_scope.no_double_counting: Initialization, begin/sync, guard setup and updates are subsets of the reported entry or producer totals. Add only separately reported standalone guard helper time to its decode-only counter; never add it to producer+decoder again.
initialization_scope.parameter_passing: HL/DE for raw decoders and input_pointer/block_end/slice_target for coroutines are ready at the API boundary. Host ABI fixture writes are not timed Z80 instructions; they are not a free implementation of a separate callable initializer.
initialization_scope.required_initializer: No required external target table/cache/offset initializer for resident/ordinary profiles. Guarded suppliers must publish frontiers and run the guard patcher; the full guest producer evidence counts both.
initialization_scope.static_image: Code, emitted tables and initial data are installed as binary image; there is no target table generation or runtime image-copy initializer in these APIs.

ordinary_derivation.scope: From begin through the raw entry jump, before the first token/literal parser; included, never add again.
